a0.message: refactor(ui): bind club detail route to F0 theme roles

accepted_changes: replace the text back arrow with SemanticIcon arrow-left/inline
bind hero gradient, fact cards, meetings, empty state, note and action target to F0 route-theme roles
preserve external meeting-link noopener noreferrer nofollow behavior
preserve data projection, breadcrumbs, future/history state, copy and mobile one-column composition

residual_consumer_values.decision: do not manufacture global F0 aliases for single-route optical micro-values; A0 may replace legacy color aliases with existing --ke-color-* roles and must explicitly retain or migrate micro-layout values during route-shell closure
residual_consumer_values.pm0_effect: this accepted route-theme cluster does not by itself complete global PM0 items 12, 13 or 15

standalone_boundary.integration_rule: materialize F0-owned source first, then apply only the net route patch onto the current successor; never replace the newer successor route with an older whole-branch tree

rollback.trigger: missing token, strict gate failure, computed theme/icon/target drift or route behavior change
rollback.action: revert only the bounded club-detail substitutions and omit the corresponding F0 route-theme unit; preserve unrelated successor, A0, M0 and immutable-preview state

claims_not_made: the patch is integrated into the current successor
all route-local spacing and typography is normalized
